options.name: items
options.description: Menu items (the Menu item model: action with optional submenu items, checkbox, radio, separator, group). Ids are unique across the whole tree. An empty array is allowed.

options.name: label
options.description: aria-label of the menu. Default: localized 'Context menu'. Must be non-empty when set.

options.name: disabled
options.description: While true, right-click and the keyboard keys keep the browser's native behavior and open() is still possible; setting it closes an open menu.

options.name: renderItem
options.description: Custom item content (since 0.9.0); the label stays the accessible name and typeahead text. Nodes are reused per item and released with releaseNode when dropped.

options.name: icons
options.type: Partial<{ submenu: IconRef; checked: IconRef; radio: IconRef }>

options.name: closeOnSelect
options.description: Close after activating a checkbox or radio item. Action items always close the menu.

options.name: typeahead
options.description: Printable characters move focus to the next item whose label starts with them.

options.name: nativeModifier
options.description: 'shift': Shift+right-click is left to the browser's native menu. 'none': every right-click opens the component menu.

options.name: direction
options.description: Logical alignment, submenu side, submenu arrow keys, and chevron mirroring.

properties.name: target
properties.description: The element whose content opens the menu. It receives no ARIA attributes.

properties.name: element
properties.description: Top-level role=menu popup (popover=manual, class aui-menu aui-menu--context), appended to the target's enclosing <dialog> or <body>.

properties.name: origin
properties.description: Element the open (or last opened) menu belongs to: the right-clicked element, the focused element, or the target for open(). Null before the first open and after destroy().

methods.name: open
methods.signature: open(point?: { x: number; y: number }): void
methods.description: Open at viewport (client) coordinates, or below the target when no point is given; focus moves to the first enabled item and origin becomes the target. Non-finite coordinates throw CONTEXT_MENU_OPTIONS.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Close all levels; focus is restored only when it was inside the menu. No aui-select.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge, validate, and apply options; new items reset checkbox/radio state and close open submenus. A failed update keeps the previous options.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Close, remove all popups, listeners, and subscriptions; the target keeps the native menu again.

events.name: aui-select
events.detail: { id: string; item: MenuSelectableItem; checked?: boolean; origin: Element }
events.description: Dispatched on the target when the user activates an enabled item. origin is the element the menu was opened for; checked is the new state for checkbox and radio items.

events.name: aui-open
events.description: Dispatched on the menu element after the top level opened.

events.name: aui-close
events.description: Dispatched on the menu element after all levels closed.

cssClasses.name: aui-menu--context
cssClasses.description: Added to the top-level popup; sets a 12rem minimum inline size.

cssClasses.name: aui-menu (and all aui-menu__* classes)
cssClasses.description: Menu popup and items; styled by @absoluteui/components/menu/style.css.
